mapper.sql: select r.id, r.version, r.name, r.frequency, r.day_number, r.type_difference, r.type, r.account, r.other_account, r.money, r.remark, r.next_run_date, r.enabled, r.last_run_date, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, c.type_name, a.account_name from px_bookkeeping_recurring r left join px_bookkeeping_classification c on r.type = c.id left join px_bookkeeping_account a on r.account = a.id
mapper.select: where r.del_flag = 0 and r.enabled = 1 and r.next_run_date <= #{date} order by r.next_run_date
mapper.insert: insert into px_bookkeeping_recurring (version, name, frequency, day_number, type_difference, type, account, other_account, money, remark, next_run_date, enabled, create_by, create_time) values (#{version}, #{name}, #{frequency}, #{dayNumber}, #{typeDifference}, #{type}, #{account}, #{otherAccount}, #{money}, #{remark}, #{nextRunDate}, #{enabled}, #{createBy}, #{createTime})
